purpose: Bounded identity and geometry acceptance of the public Mangaung Cadastre_2025 ArcGIS layer through the existing arcgis-source adapter. This is a proposal only; no source catalogue/runtime files are changed.
privacy: Only OBJECTID transport manifests, SG_CODE, PARCEL_NR, counts and geometry hashes are saved. No owner, address, contact, transfer, price, deed, account or valuation fields are requested.
